public_rationale: The assertion of broad agreement that the later improvement was merely modest is contradicted. Contemporary results reported large gains in data analysis, coding, and mathematics, with an independent mathematics evaluation corroborating improvement. METR also found important practical limits. This verdict does not establish that o1 improved capabilities overall more than GPT-4 had, or validate the graph's implied distances.
limitations: The result depends on the explicit claim of agreement; the aggregate comparison remains unsettled.
